status: prepared candidate; not installed or accepted for real Camera captures
scope: One ARM64 conditional branch selects the original Java pointer-event protocol. APS adapter load/export failures and unrelated checks remain intact; no helper is removed or capability result fabricated. Source JNI glue exports the original four native events plus its own JNI_OnLoad and forwards actual fields/pointers/return values to unchanged stock helpers. Original APK/signature, frame/format/Exif/debug/fd, normal permissions, firmware and global linker policy are retained.
limits: Live capture proves a valid3072x4096 APS packet reaches an incompatible legacy flat-key parser as zeros. Authentic SDK map dispatch through installed framework receiver and scratch JNI encodes/decodes synthetic512x512 and3072x4096 NV21 with synthetic Exif. The isolated test explicitly selects candidate JNI in its own process; it does not validate installed boot-classloader selection, real Camera UID/packet ownership, callbacks, photo saving, colors or general metadata. Empty-Exif synthetic input fails decoding through the stock ICC helper; do not claim general empty-Exif support. Final consolidated packaging, permission/namespace checks and real captures remain required.
